description: This file implements authentication-related API endpoints for a FastAPI application, including user registration, login, and retrieving current user info. It defines routes for user registration, login to obtain JWT tokens, and fetching the authenticated user's profile.

classes.name: User
classes.description: User model representing user data in the database.

classes.name: UserRead
classes.description: Schema for returning user data in responses.

methods.name: UserRead register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user with hashed password.

methods.name: Token login_for_access_token( form_data: Annotated[OAuth2PasswordRequestForm, Depends()], db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles user login and JWT token creation after verifying credentials.

methods.name: UserRead read_users_me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's profile.

ctags.name: login_for_access_token
ctags.signature: ( form_data: Annotated[OAuth2PasswordRequestForm, Depends()], db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^def register_user(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserRead:$/
